description.value: A Toquaht Nation-operated bayfront campground on Barkley Sound with 67 sites, a marina, and a dedicated kayak launch — the main land base for paddlers heading into the Broken Group Islands; well-developed with a pump track and playground but seasonal (May 15–Sept 15), $55/night, no cell service, and a busy booking calendar.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the fully accessible website, which corroborates all OSM contact details and provides detailed amenity information across multiple subpages. The front page update section confirms potable water on site, a covered gym area, a paved pump track welcoming bikes, and Wi-Fi at the office; the amenities page confirms restrooms, a small camp store, and tent-only platforms but does not confirm showers as operational (power connection described as 'coming soon'). Reservations are explicitly accepted online; no hiker/biker rate, laundry, device charging, or camping fuel are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM address ('Toquaht Bay, V0R 3A0') is less complete than the website version ('Toquaht Bay, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0'); website version used for address field.

Shower facilities are unconfirmed for 2026: front page states 'Power will be connected soon with new washroom and shower facilities,' indicating they are not yet operational at time of website capture.
No cell service on site; Wi-Fi is available at the office only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating Indigenous-owned campground serving as the primary land base for Broken Group Islands access, with tent-only platforms, potable water, a pump track welcoming cyclists, and online reservations — clear value for touring cyclists on BC's west coast.

wow_evidence: Toquaht Nation-operated bayfront campground…paved pump track welcoming bikes
